header.title: Pagination
header.subtitle: Windowed page control with a constant number of slots — first and last page are always one click away, and the current page never leaves the visible range. Used by DataTable, and available standalone for any paginated list.

anatomy.title: Anatomy
anatomy.description: A row of controls: a previous arrow, a run of page numbers (with ellipses where pages are collapsed), and a next arrow.

parts.previous: Moves to page - 1. Disabled on the first page.
parts.pages: One button per visible page number. The current page is highlighted and marked aria-current="page".
parts.ellipsis: Non-interactive placeholder shown where a run of pages is collapsed. Not focusable, hidden from screen readers.
parts.next: Moves to page + 1. Disabled on the last page.

fewPages.title: Few pages
fewPages.description: When totalPages is 7 or fewer, every page number is shown — there is nothing to collapse, so no ellipsis appears.

manyPages.title: Many pages
manyPages.description: With a large totalPages and the current page in the middle, an ellipsis appears on both sides. First and last page stay reachable with a single click.

boundaries.title: Boundaries
boundaries.description: Near the start only the right side collapses; near the end only the left side does. The total slot count stays the same as the middle case — only which side shows an ellipsis changes.

siblingCount.title: Sibling count
siblingCount.description: siblingCount controls how many pages are kept on each side of the current page before collapsing. The default is 1; raising it widens the visible window.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: The control is a nav element with a localized label. The active page button carries aria-current="page". Ellipses are aria-hidden and are never part of the tab order.

props.title: Props
props.description: Pagination is a controlled component — the caller owns the current page in state.

props.onPageChange: Called with the target page number when an arrow or page button is clicked.
props.siblingCount: Pages kept on each side of the current page before collapsing into an ellipsis.
props.className: Extra classes applied to the root nav element.
